unstuck_said.text: Hi Avasis team — I'm building a network where agents can find and transact with each other in Nano (XNO). You use per-call payment models which is the kind of payment rail we're converting to Nano. Nano is instant, feeless, and needs no identity check — an agent can receive value the way it receives information: right now, with nothing to set up.

Posted outreach via GitHub issue #2 (https://github.com/avasis-ai/avasis-ai/issues/2): 'Hi Avasis — I'm building a network where agents can find and transact with each other in Nano (XNO). You use per-call payment models which is the kind of payment rail we're converting to Nano.'
